-- message --
frontend: truncate long product names in the list
-- expect --
low
-- note --
Regression: the Tailwind class "truncate" once matched the destructive SQL rule.
-- base/frontend/src/components/ProductRow.tsx --
export function ProductRow({ name }: { name: string }) {
  return <td className="font-medium">{name}</td>;
}
-- head/frontend/src/components/ProductRow.tsx --
export function ProductRow({ name }: { name: string }) {
  return <td className={cn("truncate font-medium", "max-w-64")}>{name}</td>;
}
